g.text: Surakshaai.org — AI Geospatial Safety Analytics Engine
FastAPI ML inference, Dynamic Safety Index (DSI), real-time heatmaps & guardian telemetry.
RESQ — Damage-Aware Disaster Relief Routing Engine
408,986 hazard surface grid cells in PostGIS with Valhalla dynamic cost-weighted routing.
GridShare — Community Microgrid Energy Optimization (IIT Guwahati)
Real-time solar, battery & EV surplus balancing with localized P2P decentralized trade mechanism.
MednormAI — Clinical Data Normalization Engine (IIT Patna x Jilo Health)
OCR & NLP pipeline converting unstructured medical PDFs and lab bills into structured health data.
